title: Each A/R report opens with its opening column marked as sorted
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role, with {Location-A} as your current location.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Each of the three A/R reports has open documents on today's date.
  • Starting screen: Reports (top menu; its left menu lists the A/R reports under ACCOUNTS RECEIVABLE and the A/P reports under ACCOUNTS PAYABLE) is open in a desktop browser window 1440 px wide.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Open A/R Summary and look at the column headers.
  2. Open A/R Detail and look at the column headers.
  3. Open A/R Collection and look at the column headers.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the customer name column (the first column) is marked as the sorted column (a small arrow beside its heading), and no other column is.
  • Step 2: "Customer full name" is marked as the sorted column (a small arrow beside its heading), and no other column is.
  • Step 3: "Date" is marked as the sorted column (a small arrow beside its heading), and no other column is.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 5 (21 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 22 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11531 (Story 1, Reports open in QuickBooks name order)

  • S1-R7: “The column the report opened on is marked as sorted: the name column on the Summaries and Detail reports, the Date column on Collection and Unpaid Invoices.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
